meta.title: Choerodon
meta.description: Brings Choerodon into DSH: a sidebar panel signs in, picks an organization and project, and exposes that project's models to DSH's model picker under the choerodon- prefix. The task board groups work items by status, shows only your own by default, and can switch to everyone's; epic and assignee filters are searchable multi-selects that re-query the server, and the toolbar searches work items by summary or description. A card's detail lets you reassign (pick a member, take it yourself, or clear), read and post comments (@name becomes a real mention), edit estimate and remaining hours, click a transition to change status, upload attachments and download them through the platform's signed URL (the private bucket rejects direct links), and open a branch or worktree for the task with a session that already carries its context — before the session is created you choose to keep the current assignee, take it yourself, or pick someone else, and whether to advance the status. The toolbar creates a work item (type, priority, component, sprint, reporter, estimate, planned dates, attachments), and a card can be duplicated into a new one. Model tools: choerodon_board, choerodon_issue, choerodon_search, choerodon_attachment_url, choerodon_dict, choerodon_create_issue, choerodon_update, choerodon_update_fields, choerodon_change_type, choerodon_comment, choerodon_estimate, choerodon_activity, choerodon_worklog, choerodon_inbox, choerodon_worktree, choerodon_delete_issue. Credentials and device identity live in $DSH_HOME/choerodon-harness/state.json; the plugin never runs push, merge, rebase, or reset --hard.
